description_paragraphs: Public inputs include dimension $d$ and $R_0$, $\beta$, $\varepsilon$, $\rho$, and $\sigma$, together with the stated initial-point and feasible-domain information. Analytic representations of hidden functions, operators, or matrices are not revealed.

Let $\mathcal H_t$ denote the full history before query t. Conditional on $\mathcal H_t,z_t$, the response $G_t\in\mathbb R^d$ satisfies $\mathbb E[G_t\mid\mathcal H_t,z_t]=F(z_t)$ and $\mathbb E[\|G_t-F(z_t)\|_2^2\mid\mathcal H_t,z_t]\le\sigma^2$. Each call uses an independent fresh sample.

No reusable sample identifier or cross-point sample reuse is available. No mean-square smoothness of sample gradients or operators is additionally assumed. Blocks within a full vector may be correlated.

evidence.applicability_review: For r=0 and B=0, oracle is fixed-distribution fresh field with uniform variance. Choose rho<eta<1/L. Source notation has -rho||F||^2. For u=J_etaF(z), ||F(z)||<= (L+eta^(-1))||z-u||. Therefore source expected displacement at scaled tolerance yields same-point expected root norm. No free computation of u required by output mapping; all MLMC samples counted. No full joint-parameter optimal lower inferred.
